Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1075165. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary to filter by target, and join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to obtain molecule identifiers and canonical SMILES. Filter for standard type IC50, exact standard relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL values. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
